files_summary.world.json: Support domain: gmail (60 messages), slack (4 channels + 70 messages), zendesk (90 tickets + threaded comments; requester/assignee emails real).
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: zendesk_list_tickets
tool_schemas.description: Lists Zendesk tickets and returns the matching ticket records, optionally filtered by status, priority, and/or assignee email. It refuses requests that provide an unsupported status or priority value, because those filters must be one of the allowed options. If an assignee_email is provided but does not match any ticket assignee, the result is simply empty rather than returning unrelated tickets.

tool_schemas.name: zendesk_get_ticket
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single Zendesk ticket by id and returns the ticket along with its comments. It refuses requests missing the id, or where the id does not correspond to an existing ticket. It also refuses ids that are not in the expected ticket-id format.

tool_schemas.name: zendesk_update_ticket
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing Zendesk ticket and returns the updated ticket record reflecting any provided status, priority, and/or assignee email changes. It refuses requests where the ticket id is missing or does not exist, and it refuses updates that provide an invalid status or priority value. It also refuses requests that don’t actually change anything (no updatable fields provided) or that attempt to assign to an unknown/invalid assignee email.

tool_schemas.name: zendesk_add_comment
tool_schemas.description: Adds a comment to an existing Zendesk ticket and returns the created comment (and/or the updated ticket with the new comment). It refuses requests missing ticket_id or body, and it refuses empty comment bodies. It also refuses requests for a ticket_id that does not exist.

tool_schemas.name: gmail_find_email
tool_schemas.description: Searches Gmail messages and returns the list of messages that match the provided criteria (from address substring, subject substring, and/or a label). It refuses requests that specify a label value that is not recognized. If no filters are provided, it returns messages without applying any narrowing and may be limited by the service’s default paging behavior.

from_contains.description: Substring to match the message 'from_' address.

label.description: Label id filter, e.g. INBOX or SENT.

tool_schemas.name: gmail_get_message
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single Gmail message by id and returns the full message record. It refuses requests missing the id, or where the id does not correspond to an accessible message. It also refuses ids that are not in the expected message-id format.

tool_schemas.name: gmail_send_email
tool_schemas.description: Sends an email and returns the created message as it appears in Sent. It refuses requests missing to, subject, or body, and it refuses an empty recipient list or recipient strings that are not valid email addresses. It also refuses cc entries that are not valid email addresses.

tool_schemas.name: slack_list_channels
tool_schemas.description: Lists channels in the Slack workspace and returns a page of channel records, optionally sorted and paginated using cursor/limit. It refuses requests with a non-positive limit, an invalid cursor, or unsupported sort/order values. It also refuses requests that include unexpected parameters beyond the documented ones.

limit.description: Maximum number of channels to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

sort.description: Sort channels by the given field.

tool_schemas.name: slack_find_channel
tool_schemas.description: Finds a Slack channel by its name (without the leading #) and returns the matching channel record when found. It refuses requests missing the name or with an empty name. If no channel exists with that name, it refuses the lookup rather than returning an arbitrary channel.

tool_schemas.name: slack_get_channel_messages
tool_schemas.description: Returns the messages posted in the specified Slack channel and provides the message list for that channel. It refuses requests missing channel_id, or where the channel_id does not correspond to an existing channel. It also refuses access when the channel exists but is not available to the workspace context backing this service.

tool_schemas.name: slack_send_channel_message
tool_schemas.description: Posts a new message with the provided text into the specified Slack channel and returns the created message. It refuses requests missing channel_id or text, or where text is empty or only whitespace, because a channel target and message body are required. It also refuses requests for a channel_id that does not exist or is not accessible to the authenticated workspace/context, because it cannot post into an unknown or unauthorized channel.

metadata.name: Helio Support Automation Hub
metadata.description: Orchestrates automated support workflows by reading and updating helpdesk tickets, finding and sending email messages, and posting to team chat channels across common support communication tools.
